description: This file defines a SlotsService class for managing slot reservations, availability, and related operations in a scheduling system, including methods for fetching, reserving, updating, and deleting slots, with dependency injections and error handling.

classes.name: SlotsService_2024_09_04
classes.description: Service class for managing slot availability, reservations, and updates with dependency injections and business logic.

methods.name: fetchAndFormatSlots
methods.description: Fetches available slots and formats them, with error handling for invalid time ranges.

methods.name: getAvailableSlots
methods.description: Transforms input query and retrieves available slots.

methods.name: getAvailableSlotsWithRouting
methods.description: Transforms routing input query and retrieves available slots.

methods.name: reserveSlot
methods.description: Reserves a slot after validation, including permission checks, date validation, and overlap checks.

methods.name: checkSlotOverlap
methods.description: Checks if a slot overlaps with existing reservations.

methods.name: validateSlotDuration
methods.description: Validates if the provided slot duration is valid for the event type.

methods.name: canSpecifyCustomReservationDuration
methods.description: Determines if a user can specify a custom reservation duration based on ownership or memberships.

methods.name: canSpecifyCustomReservationDurationIndividualEvent
methods.description: Checks if user can specify custom duration for individual event.

methods.name: canSpecifyCustomReservationDurationTeamEvent
methods.description: Checks if user can specify custom duration for team event based on memberships.

methods.name: getReservedSlot
methods.description: Retrieves a reserved slot by UID.

methods.name: updateReservedSlot
methods.description: Updates an existing reserved slot with new details after validation.

methods.name: deleteReservedSlot
methods.description: Deletes a reserved slot by UID.
